study: N2 part 1: the three N1 LivenessNet checkpoints on the NUAA official-train frames of sessions 01-02 not used for fitting or early stopping

frozen_face.source: src/tesi_app/face.py of the development repository at commit 0ac7143 (16 September 2026), the earliest committed version of our detector module, which reproduces the cache nuaa_1500.npz (built on 12 September 2026) bit for bit (cache-check); from 24 September (our change 44971f3) the RetinaFace box is one pixel narrower and shorter
frozen_face.loaded_as: tesi_app.face_0ac7143 (registered in sys.modules; the current face.py is never used by this study)

preprocessing.chain: train_cnn.preprocess (unchanged): cv2.imread, detector.detect, Face.crop(margin=0.15, square=True) or the whole image when no face, cv2.resize 256x256 INTER_AREA, BGR to RGB, advanced_image_enhancement of the reference create_datasets.py, uint8
preprocessing.cache_environment: OpenCV 4.11.0 (opencv-python==4.11.0.86 pinned in requirements.txt), under which the cache of 12 September 2026 reproduces; recorded at every step (a different OpenCV may change the detector output)

cache_check.rule: every one of the 6,000 frames of the cache (X_train and X_test, in sampling order) must be reproduced bit for bit from its original file with the frozen detector and the chain above; one different frame fails the check

parity.rule: for every key of the parity list and every N1 seed: the frame reproduced from the original equals the cache row bit for bit, and |score_attack recomputed on CPU - score_attack stored in the N1 scores_test.csv| <= tolerance_abs; one divergence fails the check
parity.selection: per test subject of nuaa_cnn_test, the first bona fide key and the first attack key in key order (a rule fixed before any computation; subjects without a class give one key); the list is ordered by subject, then class (bona fide first); it must have n_keys entries and the SHA-256 below (one key per line, newline-terminated); it is written at check to the restricted parity_keys.csv, never to a public file

target.name: sessions_01_02
target.definition: rows of nuaa_official_train.csv whose key is neither in nuaa_cnn_train.csv nor in nuaa_cnn_early_stopping.csv, sorted by key
target.originals: every file located by key under the images folder, in the prepared layout <class>_<split>/<name> or in the raw mirror layout ClientRaw|ImposterRaw/<subject>/<name without the leading subject field>; a symbolic link is refused; SHA-256 and size must equal the manifest row before use

reference.name: session_03
reference.definition: the 3,000 nuaa_cnn_test scores of the N1 study (scores_test.csv of every seed, SHA-256 above), read as they are: no rescoring
reference.strata: subject x class, for the 9 subjects of the target; a class absent in a set gives NA, never 0

metrics.aggregation: values of every seed, median and range (minimum-maximum); no seed selection, no threshold change, no score inversion
metrics.distributions: score_attack histogram per class, 10 bins of width 0.1 on [0, 1] (last bin closed), per seed, for the 491 target frames, the 3,000 session 03 frames and the session 03 frames of the target subjects
metrics.public: aggregate.json, aggregate.md, figure_distributions.png, figure_groups.png (both figures built from aggregate.json only): no identifiers, no per-image rows, no per-subject values (checked by the forbidden-content scan)
metrics.restricted: target_manifest.csv, parity_keys.csv, frames_target.csv, parity.csv, seed<N>/scores_sessions.csv, seed<N>/per_subject.csv, per_subject_all_seeds.csv, strata_all_seeds.csv, figure_strata.png (per-subject strata, no identifiers)
